translations.web: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?
translations.bsb: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison?’
translations.kjv: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison
